heading: INT. GONDOLA CAR - MOUNTAIN LIFT - DUSK

units.text: INT. GONDOLA CAR - MOUNTAIN LIFT - DUSK
A small glass cabin swinging high above a pine valley.
Snow-dusted peaks turn pink.
The cabin has stopped.
IMOGEN HARTLEY-SOTO, thirties, grips the rail.
Across from her, FERDINAND "FERN" ABARA, thirties, takes off his skis and wedges them against the seat.
In the next cabin, twenty feet away, an old couple, MARGUERITE and ALOYSIUS KELLERMAN, seventies, peer across the gap and wave.
The cabin sways.
Imogen yelps, Fern grabs her hand, the Kellermans laugh and wave harder, and Imogen pulls free and grips the rail again.
Fern, this is the second time you've promised me a scenic view.
units.name: IMOGEN

units.text: It is a scenic view.
units.name: FERN

units.text: We're stuck.
units.name: IMOGEN

units.text: We're stuck with a scenic view.
units.name: FERN

units.text: The speaker crackles and goes dead.
Marguerite shouts something across the gap that neither of them can hear, and Aloysius mimes a heart with his gloved hands.
Fern waves back, grinning.
Imogen covers her face and starts to laugh, and leans her forehead against the cold glass.
They think we're a couple.
units.name: IMOGEN

units.text: Aren't we?
units.name: FERN

units.text: She lifts her head.
He looks away at the peaks.
The cabin sways, then lurches into motion and carries them down toward the lights.
